items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: With the big band. He had a big band, and I played in the section.

ctx.x: I was going to bring up Birdland, because that's when it started, in '50, I guess -- the end of '49 into '50.
I worked at Birdland quite a few times. I worked there with Hawk, Coleman Hawkins, and I worked there with my band, and I worked with Bennie Green and Dizzy...
What kind of a thing did you do there with Dizzy?
